ctx.x: I was in Chicago from 1921 to 1925. And one interesting thing that I did hear and I was not aware of what I was hearing was Charlie Strait's band at the rendezvous which I got a job He was. He was. And I remember a small group when the big band would quit these five fellas would stay on the bandstand. And it would consist of tuba, piano, drums, cornet and I don't remember which other instrument. But I remember the music was a little disturbing to me. It was not in the either dance idiom like the band was playing…
Probably some of his in the mist type of thing.
